# ToolboxPro — Complete Tool Reference

> 99 free online tools that run entirely in your browser. No signup, no file uploads, no usage limits.

**Website**: https://trytoolboxpro.com
**All Tools**: https://trytoolboxpro.com/tools

This document provides a comprehensive reference for every tool available on ToolboxPro. Each entry includes the tool name, URL, category, a full description, and a "when to use" note to help you determine which tool is right for a given task.

## Why ToolboxPro?

- **Privacy-first**: All processing happens client-side using JavaScript, Canvas API, and WebAssembly. No files are ever uploaded to a server.
- **No signup**: No account, email, or personal data required for any tool.
- **No limits**: No daily quotas, no watermarks, no premium tiers.
- **Free**: All tools are free for personal and commercial use.

## Categories

| # | Category | Tool Count |
|---|----------|------------|
| 1 | Developer Tools | 29 |
| 2 | Text Tools | 19 |
| 3 | Image Tools | 18 |
| 4 | PDF Tools | 5 |
| 5 | Audio Tools | 3 |

| 8 | Utilities | 13 |

**Total**: 99 tools across 8 categories.

## Developer Tools (29 tools)

Tools for software engineers, web developers, and DevOps teams. Format code, generate hashes, decode tokens, parse expressions, and test patterns — all in the browser.

### JSON Formatter & Validator

- **Category**: Developer Tools
- **Keywords**: json formatter json validator prettify json

**Description**: Format, validate, and beautify JSON data instantly. Fix syntax errors and make your JSON readable with intelligent auto-formatting and tree view.

**When to use**: Use when debugging API responses, validating JSON configuration files, or making minified JSON readable before editing.

### Base64 Encoder/Decoder

**Description**: Encode text, files, or images to Base64 format and decode them back. Perfect for inline data URIs and API testing workflows.

**When to use**: Use when embedding images as data URIs, encoding credentials for HTTP Basic Auth, or decoding Base64 API payloads.
